instance_description:
Setting: Harborline Maritime Museum runs a small traveling-exhibits program from Baltimore, coordinating loans, shipping, insurance, installations, and partner venues throughout 2026.
Scope: Scenarios may cover exhibit schedules, courier logistics, vendor coordination, condition-report follow-up, internal briefings, training records, budget coding, and monthly status communication.
Resources: Reusable records include staff profile details, exhibit project registers, service contacts, and blank text templates for venue briefs, shipment checklists, and status notes.
Exclusions: The Instance excludes visitor ticketing, school coursework, household tasks, personal finances, artifact conservation decisions, and any scenario-specific facts before later initialization.
personal_description:
Identity: Nadia Pilar Voss is the traveling-exhibits operations coordinator at Harborline Maritime Museum, based in the museum’s administrative office near the Baltimore harbor.
Responsibilities: She maintains project calendars, prepares logistics packets, coordinates couriers and crating vendors, tracks partner venue requirements, and summarizes operational risks for museum leadership.
Authority: Nadia may update internal coordination records, draft professional communications, request quotes, schedule routine meetings, and prepare expense documentation for approved exhibit work.
Restrictions: She cannot approve new loans, sign contracts, alter conservation judgments, commit unbudgeted spending, or disclose confidential lender terms without director authorization.
